/--
Converts a `String` into a `Substring` that denotes the entire string.

This is a version of `String.toRawSubstring` that doesn't have an `@[inline]` annotation.
-/
def String.toRawSubstring' (s : String) : Substring.Raw :=
  s.toRawSubstring
